define.name: MAX_BAT_LEVEL
define.description: voltage of a full battery in V (NPS and HITL start voltage, GCS)

define.name: LOW_BAT_LEVEL
define.description: low battery warning level in V

define.name: CATASTROPHIC_BAT_LEVEL
define.description: catastrophic battery level in V (fixedwing: kills the throttle)

define.name: TAKEOFF_BAT_LEVEL
define.description: minimum voltage for takeoff in V (preflight check)

define.name: MIN_MEASURABLE_BAT_LEVEL
define.description: the battery checks start once the voltage is above this level in V

define.name: BAT_NB_CELLS
define.description: number of cells in series (GCS energy panel)

define.name: BAT_CAPACITY
define.description: battery capacity in mAh (GCS energy panel)

define.name: BAT_CHEMISTRY
define.description: battery chemistry: LIPO, LIHV, LIION or LIFE (GCS energy panel)

define.name: BAT_CELL_RESISTANCE
define.description: internal resistance per cell in mOhm (GCS energy panel)

define.name: MILLIAMP_AT_FULL_THROTTLE
define.description: current at full throttle in mA, to estimate the current without a sensor

define.name: MILLIAMP_AT_IDLE_THROTTLE
define.description: current at idle throttle in mA, to estimate the current without a sensor

define.name: CURRENT_ESTIMATION_NONLINEARITY
define.description: nonlinearity of the estimated current (1 = linear)

define.name: BAT_CHECKER_DELAY
define.description: time in s below a level before the low or critical flag is set
